scope: local consumer boundaries, not independent cross-owner acceptance

boundaries.contract: Opposite First and confirmation arrays retain owner order (not locally sorted), positional alignment and callback stability required. Canonical stop uses number cache only for exact indexed object; context start discarded. E owner sequence reset setter clears direct cache; this is not proof of freshness under arbitrary mutation.

OA16 may reject provisional noncanonical geometry, or return canonical replacement without revalidating its confirmation; OA20 threshold applies to returned canonical timestamp. OA16 bounded flag is unused internally but remains in OA19 key.

Native crossing delegated unchanged Decimal stop level. Base search uses half-open lower window from max(confirmation,range_start) to range_end, strict less unless order direction bearish, then strict greater; cache stores None and event tuple. E live override uses dirty-time and continuation search; no claim of general live equivalence or arbitrary callback behavior.

Candidate collector calls OA19 without threshold, then merges identity and separately enforces deadline and ownership; primary path supplies exact stop as threshold, no deadline, bounded false; registration can append direct if identity absent. Neither caller policy is a universal local OA20 constraint. No ledger mutation performed by OA20 itself; delegated caches can mutate.
